sloka: इत्यवं विलपन्तं तं शोकविह्वलितेन्द्रियम् ।विवेष्टमानं करुणमुच्छ्वसन्तं पुनःपुनः ।राममाश्वासयन् वीरः सुषेणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.१०२.१४ ।।
transliteration: ityavaṁ vilapantaṁ taṁ śokavihvalitendriyam ।viveṣṭamānaṁ karuṇamucchvasantaṁ punaḥpunaḥ ।rāmamāśvāsayan vīraḥ suṣeṇo vākyamabravīt ।। 6.102.14 ।।

translations.english: 'What purpose is there to fight in battle or in life with Lakshmana lying in the forefront struck in the battlefield?'
